# cato_allocated_ip (Resource)

Manages one account-scoped SYSTEM public IP allocation at an explicit PoP. BYOIP creation/release require private inputs absent from the public SDK and are unsupported. Import using the allocation ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Allocates a new public IP. Only this allocation is released on destruction.
resource "cato_allocated_ip" "example" {
  type         = "SYSTEM"
  pop_location = { name = "London" }
  # description = "Terraform managed public IP"
}

# type and pop_location changes require replacement.
# BYOIP allocation/release need private API inputs and are unsupported here.
# terraform import cato_allocated_ip.example ALLOCATION_ID
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `type` (String) Allocation type. Only SYSTEM supports the public lifecycle. Changes require replacement.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description. Removing this value clears it.
- `pop_location` (Attributes) PoP reference, required for SYSTEM allocations. Changes require replacement. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pop_location))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource ID
- `ip` (String) Allocated public IP address
- `state` (String) Allocation state returned by the API
- `subnet` (String) Allocated subnet returned by the API

### Nested Schema for `pop_location`

Optional:

- `id` (String) PoP ID
- `name` (String) PoP name
